cases.title: 10 customers buy the last 3 items at the same moment: exactly 3 succeed
database: stock is exactly 0, never negative

sql.q: select stock from product_variants where variant_id = $1

cases.title: database: exactly 3 orders and 3 items were created for it

sql.q: select count(distinct oi.order_id)::int o, coalesce(sum(oi.quantity),0)::int q from order_items oi join orders o on o.order_id = oi.order_id where oi.variant_id = $1 and o.status <> 'cancelled'

cases.title: database: the ledger for it adds up (3 in, 3 sold = 0)

sql.q: select coalesce(sum(delta),0)::int s from inventory_movements where variant_id = $1

cases.title: the shop shows it as out of stock
same order sent 8 times at once (same key): only one is created
database: one order and stock reduced by 5 only (500 to 495)

sql.q: select (select count(*)::int from orders where idempotency_key = $1) n, (select stock from product_variants where variant_id = $2) s

cases.title: a restock and a purchase at the same moment never lose an update
6 customers buy 2 each (stock 10) while it is also adjusted: totals stay consistent
database: stock is 0 and the ledger matches

sql.q: select (select stock from product_variants where variant_id = $1) s, (select coalesce(sum(delta),0)::int from inventory_movements where variant_id = $1) l

cases.title: INVARIANT: no variant has negative stock

sql.q: select count(*)::int n from product_variants where stock < 0

cases.title: INVARIANT: every variant's stock equals its ledger total

sql.q: select count(*)::int n from product_variants v where coalesce((select sum(m.delta) from inventory_movements m where m.variant_id = v.variant_id),0) <> coalesce(v.stock,0)

cases.title: INVARIANT: every ledger row's stock_after matches a real running total

sql.q: select count(*)::int n from (select stock_after, sum(delta) over (partition by variant_id order by created_at, movement_id) run from inventory_movements) x where x.stock_after <> x.run

cases.title: INVARIANT: product stock_quantity equals the sum of its variants

sql.q: select count(*)::int n from products p where p.stock_quantity is distinct from (select coalesce(sum(v.stock),0) from product_variants v where v.product_id = p.product_id) and exists (select 1 from product_variants v where v.product_id = p.product_id)

cases.title: INVARIANT: a product's min_price is the cheapest visible variant

sql.q: select count(*)::int n from products p where exists (select 1 from product_variants v where v.product_id = p.product_id and v.is_visible) and p.min_price is distinct from (select min(v.sell_price) from product_variants v where v.product_id = p.product_id and v.is_visible)

cases.title: INVARIANT: every order item points at an order that exists

sql.q: select count(*)::int n from order_items oi where not exists (select 1 from orders o where o.order_id = oi.order_id)

cases.title: INVARIANT: no order has a negative total or negative payments

sql.q: select (select count(*)::int from orders where sub_total < 0) a, (select count(*)::int from order_payments where amount <= 0) b

cases.title: INVARIANT: payments never exceed the order total

sql.q: select count(*)::int n from orders o where coalesce((select sum(amount) from order_payments p where p.order_id = o.order_id),0) > o.sub_total + coalesce(o.tax,0) + coalesce(o.shipping_fee,0) - coalesce(o.discount,0)

cases.title: INVARIANT: only cancelled orders have a cancel time

sql.q: select count(*)::int n from orders where status <> 'cancelled' and cancelled_at is not null

cases.title: INVARIANT: orders cancelled during this test have a cancel time (3 old migrated ones may lack it)

sql.q: select count(*)::int n from orders where status = 'cancelled' and cancelled_at is null and created_at > now() - interval '1 day'
select count(*)::int n from orders where status = 'cancelled' and cancelled_at is null

cases.title: INVARIANT: only one collection is the main banner

sql.q: select count(*)::int n from collections where is_premium
